Questions before you start?

Here’s how Purvey fits into your business.

What is Purvey?+

Purvey brings your online storefront, products, inventory, orders and customer records into one place, so you can keep your business organised.

Do I need an existing website?+

No. Purvey gives your business a hosted storefront. Add your business details and products, then share your store link with customers.

Can I keep selling through WhatsApp and Instagram?+

Yes. Keep using your social channels to promote your products and talk to customers. Share your Purvey store link so they can browse and place an order. This does not require connecting your social accounts.

Can I manage sizes and colours?+

Yes. Product variations let you organise options such as size and colour, along with the stock available for each option.

What happens after the 14-day Growth access?+

You return to the permanent Free plan unless you upgrade to Starter or Growth. Your data is retained; features and capacity follow your current plan.

How do I get started?+

Create your merchant account, add your business details and upload your products. Your account starts on Free with 14 days of Growth access.
